description: Charge the previewed checkout with the signed-in buyer's own saved card, off session, or with a Stripe shared payment token when the SDK supports it. Pass confirmation_token from quick_buy or preview_checkout. A token or total that does not match the summary is rejected and nothing is charged. The same idempotency key does not create a second charge. Charges of US$1,000 or more, and cards that need authentication, return requires_action plus a checkout link. Returns confirmed only after the PaymentIntent succeeds and the order exists. Requires sign-in with buyer access. OAuth discovery: /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (scope buyer:purchase). Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token from the summary. Must match that checkout. A mismatch is rejected.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

payment.description: shared_payment_token when the Stripe SDK supports it, or saved_card true.

saved_card.description: Charge the card saved on the ForthClear account.

name: confirm_purchase

status.description: quoted, pending, requires_action, confirmed, failed, or cancelled.

title: Confirm purchase
